gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Join us at Working Draft Beer Co for a night of samba music and tasty food. Saideira Pagode will be bringing their Brazilian rhythms and we’ll have fresh, authentic Brazilian food as well! Food service starts at 5 (and it goes pretty quickly!) and the Samba will fill the taproom from 7-9 pm.
